scope: Independent future native-build output vectors; not production results. Paths are controlled display inputs. Encode stdout and stderr as UTF-8 without BOM, preserving every LF and trailing space.

cases.name: redirected-success
cases.condition: Publication confirmed, stdout redirected, no warnings

cases.name: console-success

cases.name: usage

cases.stderr: usage: ube --build-native <project.UBE> [-o <destination>] [--jobs N] (N: 1..4)
